verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ מִיַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְמֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָה הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִירִיח֛וֹ בָּהָ֖ר בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ mî·yar·dên yə·rî·ḥōw lə·mê yə·rî·ḥōw miz·rā·ḥāh ham·miḏ·bār ‘ō·leh mî·rî·ḥōw bā·hār bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel
verses.literalPt: SAIU depois a sorte dos filhos de José, desde o Jordão, na direção de Jericó, junto às águas de Jericó, para o oriente, estendendo-se pelo deserto que sobe de Jericó pelas montanhas de Betel.

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל הָאַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā mib·bêṯ- ’êl lū·zāh wə·‘ā·ḇar ’el- gə·ḇūl hā·’ar·kî ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth
verses.literalPt: E de Betel vai para Luz, e passa ao termo dos arquitas, até Atarote,

verses.original: וְיָֽרַד־ יָ֜מָּה אֶל־ גְּב֣וּל הַיַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית־ חוֹרֹ֛ן תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְעַד־ גָּ֑זֶר וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתוֹ יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ- yām·māh ’el- gə·ḇūl hay·yap̄·lê·ṭî ‘aḏ gə·ḇūl bêṯ- ḥō·w·rōn taḥ·tō·wn wə·‘aḏ- gā·zer wə·hā·yū ṯō·ṣə·ʾō·ṯō yām·māh
verses.literal: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer and it ended . . . at the Sea
verses.literalPt: E desce do lado do ocidente ao termo de Jafleti, até ao termo de Bete-Horom de baixo, e até Gezer, indo terminar no mar.

verses.literal: So Ephraim and Manasseh the sons of Joseph received their inheritance
verses.literalPt: Assim alcançaram a sua herança os filhos de José, Manassés e Efraim.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָם֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַד־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇūl bə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām way·hî gə·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯām miz·rā·ḥāh ‘aṭ·rō·wṯ ’ad·dār ‘aḏ- bêṯ ḥō·w·rōn ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans . . . The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar . . . in the east to Upper Beth-horon
verses.literalPt: E foi o termo dos filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias, como se segue: o termo da sua herança para o oriente era Atarote-Adar até Bete-Horom de cima;

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל הַיָּ֗מָּה הַֽמִּכְמְתָת֙ מִצָּפ֔וֹן וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְעָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔וֹ מִמִּזְרַ֖ח יָנֽוֹחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā hag·gə·ḇūl hay·yām·māh ham·miḵ·mə·ṯāṯ miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·nā·saḇ hag·gə·ḇūl miz·rā·ḥāh ta·’ă·naṯ ši·lōh wə·‘ā·ḇar ’ō·w·ṯōw mim·miz·raḥ yā·nō·w·ḥāh
verses.literal: and out toward the Sea From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east
verses.literalPt: E sai este termo para o ocidente junto a Micmetá, desde o norte, e torna este termo para o oriente até Taanate-Siló, e passa por ela desde o oriente a Janoa;

verses.original: וְיָרַ֥ד מִיָּנ֖וֹחָה עֲטָר֣וֹת וְנַעֲרָ֑תָה וּפָגַע֙ בִּֽירִיח֔וֹ וְיָצָ֖א הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ mî·yā·nō·w·ḥāh ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ wə·na·‘ă·rā·ṯāh ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ bî·rî·ḥōw wə·yā·ṣā hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan
verses.literalPt: E desce desde Janoa a Atarote e a Naarate e toca em Jericó, terminando no Jordão.

verses.original: מִתַּפּ֜וּחַ יֵלֵ֨ךְ הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּ֑מָּה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mit·tap·pū·aḥ yê·lêḵ hag·gə·ḇūl yām·māh na·ḥal qā·nāh wə·hā·yū ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw hay·yām·māh zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended . . . at the Sea This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: De Tapua vai este termo para o ocidente ao ribeiro de Caná, terminando no mar; esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias,

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כָּֽל־ הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ham·miḇ·dā·lō·wṯ liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- mə·naš·šeh kāl- he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Mais as cidades que se separaram para os filhos de Efraim no meio da herança dos filhos de Manassés; todas aquelas cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁוּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּגָ֑זֶר וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י בְּקֶ֤רֶב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־ עֹבֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hō·w·rî·šū ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḡā·zer way·yê·šeḇ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî bə·qe·reḇ ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh way·hî lə·mas- ‘ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day but they are forced laborers
verses.literalPt: E não expulsaram aos cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; e os cananeus habitam no meio dos efraimitas até ao dia de hoje; porém, sendo-lhes tributários.
